Phase 2: Samples & Upstream Mappings

Provide JSON sample bodies for each selected operation — at least one per operation is required before export.
Field mappings are optional but improve EdgeForge Engine output quality. Upstream mapping direction: source = API field name (as in the spec/JSON) → target = canonical path, e.g. Customer.customerId.
